column1: # NOTE=001 runs its applies and Sidecar deletes at kubectl -v=4. api_429_retried counts client-go's 'Got a Retry-After response' lines (a 429 with Retry-After that client-go retried; at the default verbosity it prints nothing); api_429_exhausted counts TooManyRequests errors that reached kubectl after its retries; client_throttle_waits counts client-side rate-limiter waits over 50 ms (kubectl 1.34 showed none on server-side apply). N/A = not measured (readiness waits and 005's deletes). leftover-check rows (003, one per context at each series start): namespaces = the controlplane-test namespaces present, objects = how many of them are still discovered, status LEFTOVER above CONTROLPLANE_LEFTOVER_NS_WARN.
